fields.name: Role Instance ID
fields.condition: messageCode in (PGL, PPG, PPP, PPR, PMU) OR messageCode = RSP AND triggerEvent = K25

fields.name: Role Person
fields.optionalityCitation: v2.8.2 CH15 section 15.4.7.4: the attribute table prints R, but the definition reads 'If both STF and ROL are present in the same message, populating this field is optional'. Modelled C (P4-30); v2.3 to v2.5.1 print no such sentence and keep R.

correlations.citation: HL7 v2.8.2 CH15 sec 15.4.7.4, p 33: 'This field correlates to STF-2 Staff ID Code and STF-3 Staff Name. If both STF and ROL are present in the same message, populating this field is optional. If this field is populated, then it must be populated with the same values as the correlated field.' Identifier components mapped to CX by their Chapter 2A names (XCN.1 to CX.1 ID Number, XCN.9 to CX.4 Assigning Authority, and so on).

HL7 v2.8.2 CH15 sec 15.4.7.4, p 33: 'This field correlates to STF-2 Staff ID Code and STF-3 Staff Name. If both STF and ROL are present in the same message, populating this field is optional. If this field is populated, then it must be populated with the same values as the correlated field.' Name components mapped to XPN by their Chapter 2A names; XCN.19 and XCN.20 date 'the person name' (Chapter 2A), so they map to XPN.12 and XPN.13. XCN.8 and XPN.15 have no counterpart.
